title: Stats: Barcelona open biggest La Liga lead at this stage since 2017/18 after stunning start
tweet: Barça open their biggest La Liga lead at this stage since 2017/18, 21 points from seven matches and 31 goals – 4.2 per game, 10 more than last season. The gap over Atlético, Betis and Madrid is already five points and could widen if the attack keeps pace. As things stand, the cushion is difficult to dismiss as a short‑term surge.

title: Confirmed: Barcelona sign 16-year-old Portuguese talent after successful trial
tweet: Barcelona officially sign 16‑year‑old Dany Freire after a successful trial; a three‑year deal now completes a project begun weeks earlier, showing the club’s patience with foreign‑player rules and adding new attacking depth to the youth ranks.

title: Barcelona summer signing’s incredible passing statistic puts him clear of La Liga midfielders
tweet: Rodri has recorded 368 passes completed out of 391 attempted, a 94.12 % accuracy that tops every La Liga midfielder with at least 200 attempts this season. As he continues to feature beside Pedri, his numbers suggest he is becoming the primary distribution hub, though how this will translate across a full campaign remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona academy defender on Hansi Flick’s radar following Christensen injury setback
tweet: Christensen’s likely two‑month lay‑off leaves a centre‑back gap; as things stand, Gariba’s pace and composure over short distances make him a natural fit for Flick’s system, but whether he will step up immediately remains to be seen.

title: Joint training session between the Barcelona first-team squad and Barça Atletic
tweet: Flick merged six fit first‑team men with a dozen Barça Atletic players at Ciutat Esportiva – a pragmatic move to keep rhythm amid 17 international absences. The session highlighted Eder Aller as a potential backup after Christensen injury, but the group remains a stop‑gap until the squad returns on Oct. 5. As things stand, the blend may test depth rather than forge a new core.

title: Barcelona battle with Arsenal, Chelsea and Manchester United for 15-year-old jewel
tweet: Barça already scouted 15‑year‑old Gabriel Rajkovic after he scored his first Eliteserien goal and became the youngest scorer in the league, while Manchester United, Arsenal and Chelsea follow suit. As things stand, Barça could secure the move before the Premier clubs if the youngster turns 16 next summer, but the final deal remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona teenage starlet in contention for a starting opportunity with national team
tweet: Hamza Abdelkarim has been called into Egypt’s squad for the first AFCON qualifier and could start against Angola after just one official minute for Barça. A starting berth would give the 18‑year‑old a chance to prove himself away from the club, but whether Hassan picks him remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona defender Jules Kounde named one of France vice-captains by Zidane
tweet: Jules Kounde has been named a vice‑captain of France by Zidane, a nod that reflects seniority more than current form. As things stand, the 27‑year‑old still struggles for regular minutes at Barça, so the honour may boost his confidence but does not guarantee a return to the starting XI. Whether he can translate that leadership into performance remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona economic VP claims club ‘would have to sell’ players to make signings in January
tweet: Barcelona’s economic VP confirmed that any January signing will require a player sale – a positive FFP margin alone is not enough. The club’s top priority remains completing the Spotify Camp Nou, which is expected to unlock extra revenue, but it does not change the need for cash flow from the squad.

title: Confirmed: Barcelona quartet nominated for La Liga awards for September
tweet: Barcelona quartet on the ballot for September La Liga awards: Raphinha for Player of the Month, Hansi Flick for Coach, Pau Cubarsi for U23 Player, and João Cancelo for Goal of the Month. Their performances in the first eight matches, with Raphinha’s seven‑goal haul and Cancelo’s two‑goal contribution, underline the club’s early season dominance, but the prizes will still hinge on the final fixtures of the month.
